page.layout: One block of text, centred on the page: a heading in script type, then one paragraph with a large initial P. No margin notes. Below it, faint show-through of the other side and a library stamp, which are left out.

main_text.head: Addenda ad pag. 65.
main_text.p: Petrus Cunæus vir ut eruditissimus, ita rerum Judaicarum scientissimus, laudat R. Mosem Maimonidem, qui authore R. Abraham Zacutz, Computi Judaici conditorem facit Rabbi Hillel Babylonium virum sui seculi principem. lib. 1. cap. 13. de rep. Jud. Sed quo seculo Hillel iste vixerit, nobis non constat.

page.notes: The large initial P is joined to the word "Etrus", printed as "PEtrus", and is read here as "Petrus". The ghost text of the title (IVDAORVM ANNVS LVNÆ SOLARIS, ET TVRCA-ARABVM ... NICOLAI MVLERI ...) and the faint imprint at the foot (GRONINGÆ, Excudebat Iohannes Sassius, Typographus Ordinarius, Anno 1630) are show-through from the reverse side and are not transcribed. A circular library stamp is also omitted.
